# uup_locations (Data Source)

The locations a Monitor can be checked from. A Monitor's `locations` names them by `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check a Monitor from every location.
data "uup_locations" "all" {}

resource "uup_monitor" "site" {
  project_id   = data.uup_project.main.id
  type         = "http"
  name         = "Site"
  url          = "https://example.com"
  interval_sec = 60
  locations    = slice(data.uup_locations.all.ids, 0, min(5, length(data.uup_locations.all.ids)))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Every location's `id`, such as `de`.
- `locations` (Attributes List) Every location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) The city.
- `country` (String) The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
- `id` (String) What a Monitor's `locations` names.
